hooks.command: in=$(cat); [ "$(printf "%s" "$in" | jq -r ".stop_hook_active // false")" = "true" ] && exit 0; d=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}; [ -n "$d" ] || exit 0; c=$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain -- crates config diagrams tools deploy 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$c" ] && exit 0; [ -n "$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain -- docs 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; jq -nc --arg files "$c" "{decision:\"block\",reason:(\"Code changed but nothing under docs/ moved with it:\n\" + \$files + \"\nRun the sync-docs skill (Skill tool, skill: sync-docs): changelog row, affected pages, diagrams via diagrams/*.mmd + npm run sync-diagrams, then npm run build. If this change really needs no documentation, say so and commit — the check looks for an uncommitted docs/ edit.\")}"
hooks.statusMessage: checking docs moved with the code
